apps.name: Finvio
apps.subtitle: Spending, splits and everything you own
apps.localizedDescription: Finvio for iPhone: transactions, splits, budgets, bills, card reminders, portfolio and CPF, synced with finvio.xyz.

versions.localizedDescription: - Card catalogue refreshed to Oct 2026 (generated from finance-app eb34520): 112 Singapore credit cards across 15 banks in the New account picker, with current earn rates, fees and minimum income; reward estimates use the updated rates (OCBC 365 cap S$80, Trust Freedom 1.5%/0.5%, UOB PRVI 1.4/2.4 mpd and more)

- Skipped emails say why: Settings → Email shows "Skipped" with the reason underneath (inbound_emails.skip_reason: an account rule, or a cancelled card purchase that never posted); rows from before it keep "Skipped by account rule"

- New card detection: Wealth shows "Card ending 1234" for each card your bank emails named that no account carries (inbound_emails.detected_*); Add opens New account prefilled (type, last 4, bank) and moves that card's email transactions onto it as one undo; the cross hides it here and on web (prefs.dismissedTips)

- Faster tab and page opens: owed/overpaid shares take refund totals worked out once instead of rescanning every transaction per item (a person's page with 12k transactions: 1.75 s -> 0.19 s); spending by category, budget suggestions and overdue shared shares are cached per data revision instead of recomputed on every Home/Plan render

- Smoother scroll to the top: app animations may run at ProMotion's 120 Hz (CADisableMinimumFrameDurationOnPhone), so the header's compact/full switch no longer drops the display to 60 Hz mid-bounce; the header keeps one height (38 pt) in both states so the scroll inset never shifts
- Frame log on the phone: the frame logger keeps its last 300 lines across launches, readable and shareable from Settings → About → Frame log (no Mac needed)

- Frame logger (diagnostic): every late frame is logged to Console (category frames) with the tab, whether a scroll, refresh or sync was running and whether data had just changed, plus a 10-second summary

- Empty states: Activity with no transactions offers Add a transaction and Forward bank emails instead of "Nothing here yet."; a new account's Wealth shows a Start tracking list (bank account, credit card, investment account, CPF) instead of a $0.00 net worth and four $0 tiles

- Charts: net worth draws straight lines between month-ends (the smoothed curve invented a peak) with month labels; the cash forecast gets dates and marks its lowest point; interest drops the dashed grid, flags a short month with an icon and a legend entry, not colour alone. VoiceOver reads each chart's points as date and amount
- Less cut-off text: the Cash rate moves from a badge into the subtitle (names stopped wrapping, masks stopped truncating), account names wrap in Accounts, the Interest page title is just "Interest" with the account named in its card, and a shared subscription's row shows what's owed first with a shorter "Record" button

- A new account's Home is three Get started steps (add an account, forward bank emails, add a transaction) instead of a page of $0.00; the card stays, ticking steps off, until there's an account and a transaction. An avatar with no name shows a person instead of an empty circle
- Design consistency: two button tiers, one layout per kind of sheet, one date format
- scripts/screens.sh: a PNG of every screen and sheet (light, dark, empty account) for design review, reusing the smoke-test screen list

- Updating no longer needs a manual exit: after iOS's install prompt closes, Finvio shows "Finishing update…" and goes to the Home Screen so the install starts; the update alert isn't offered again in the meantime

- README: where the app keeps data on the phone (cache, outbox, backups), how each is protected, and the outbox-unreadable.json recovery copy
- README: what the app is, layout, tests, parity, conventions (money stays Double), screenshots and releasing; per-round build notes move to docs/history
- Statement files that aren't UTF-8 open again (the Latin-1 fallback never ran: try? covered the whole ??); the photo picker label reads the profile on the main actor. No compiler warnings left
- Parity generators stamp the finance-app commit they ran against (scripts/parity/web-commit.json); check.sh, run by test.sh, warns when the web logic has moved on since
- Mockups and preview sample data compile into Debug builds only; Release (the sideloaded .ipa) has just the live app
- Failures are logged with os.Logger (subsystem xyz.finvio.ios) instead of print or dropped: sync refetches, outbox, background scheduling, notifications, backups; an unreadable outbox is kept as outbox-unreadable.json rather than overwritten
- Weekly backups get file protection: unreadable while the phone is locked, still writable from background refresh
- test.sh waits for the end of the run: a failing test's "Caught error:" no longer stops it early, and success needs the whole-run passed line
- Live tests skip when no test account is set: test.sh always passes the variables, empty when unset, so check for an empty email too
- Charts draw at once from histories saved on disk (per user, wiped on sign-out), then update; a failed fetch keeps the saved copy; history calls run beside the DB
- Price histories in one request from the shared server cache: portfolio chart fetches all holdings + FX together, single holdings are a batch of one
- Account form shows the fields that fit the type: no last 4 digits for investment accounts (optional elsewhere), perks and statement days for cards only, interest for bank and investment cash

- Interest tracking per account: rate/cap/base rate/pay day in prefs, daily accrual, Interest card + page, interest filter, manual marks in prefs (no transaction writes)
- Duplicates: amounts match to the cent; sheet titled Card payment
- Duplicates review (merge only on tap, undoable, existing ones seeded as judged) and 'Paid off credit card' (marks the bank row; card side only if asked); Duplicates/CardPayments ports with parity fixtures

- Holding stats: last price in the same currency as the average cost
- Regenerate project for new Investments files
- Investments: P&L-first summary (today, unrealised, total return), real portfolio value chart with cost line, sortable holdings with P&L and weight, movers, allocation bars; holding detail with labelled P&L and stats grid

- Parity with web aa08f09: card 'Current balance' label + Statement balance field; a typed statement figure overrides the derived one for that cycle only (accounts.statementAnchor)
- Parity with web 5831885: equal shares get the price-change prompt too (pinned at the old cut, wasEqual; Update turns it back to equal)
- Parity with web 05d0448: held payments keep their tag when the expense they settled is deleted/unsplit/unsettled; overdue shares on Home's Needs attention

- Shared subscriptions (3/3): shared-with editor, per-person status on bill rows, Record payment sheet, Shared subscriptions block on the person page, held-money note on payments; preview data and smoke tests
- Shared subscriptions (2/3): stamp shared charges (once each, remembered in automation.seen), prepayment holds, held money pays new owings, recordSettlement held option, price-change proposals
- Shared subscriptions (1/3): recurring shares and held reimbursements round-trip losslessly; SharedSubs domain port, split-aware bill merges, held money out of income; parity fixtures from the web JS
- Launch: wait for an expired saved session to refresh instead of flashing the sign-in screen
- Cash forecast is its own screen (linked from Bills and Cash); Plan has four tabs that fit
- Section tabs no longer squeeze: labels stay full size and the bar scrolls (selected tab kept in view) when they don't fit; Bills drops the duplicate Subscriptions heading

- Test: match the new income row by id (sample dates follow today)
- Spending analytics use effective (post-refund/payback) amounts

- Onboarding: Amex defaults to a credit card; Round 8 done
- Add welcome tour, first-visit tips, and a haptics pass
- Reminder suggestions: titles wrap instead of truncating
- Reminders review fixes: combined notif cap, reorder, row clip, dates, headline
- Round 8: mascot/icon cancelled
- Fix: seed preview reminders after loadProfile, not before
- Reminders: preview data, -open reminders, screen smoke coverage
- Reminders: notifications, Home attention, Settings, Siri intent
- Reminders: Plan tab UI (list, suggestions, add/edit sheet) + Bills subscriptions card
- Reminders: Swift domain port + data layer + parity fixtures
- Round 8 plan: decisions
- test.sh: DD env picks the derived-data folder (parallel worktrees)
- Round 8 plan draft: onboarding, mascot icon, reminders
- Two-factor setup waits for Verify; certificate-signed builds offer new versions when opened
- Release script: read the profile plist from a pipe correctly

- Script to re-sign the .ipa with a development certificate and profile (bundle id from the profile)
- Header Edit buttons are a pencil icon
- Actions in the header on child screens (transaction, account, person, collection, cash, cards, investments, loans, rules); time spans in days/weeks/months/years

- Parity fixtures for year/wealth ports
- Loans: shorter row subtitle
- Loans: balances today, payoff dates, pay-extra planner (avalanche vs snowball), Wealth row; parity with web
- Siri: spending this month (optionally by category, against its budget), safe to spend, goal progress, net worth
- Regular goal saving: monthly amount on a day or payday, added to hand-tracked goals or a reminder for linked ones, on-track status
- Weekly automatic backups to Files (keep 8), Back up now, settings
- Merchant renames: rename everywhere (past rows, bills, new transactions), Settings list; web parity
- Categorisation: history step, whole-word dictionary, cleaned merchant list; Fix categories review (Home + Settings); parity with web

- Accounts screen (add any kind, edit, delete with moving transactions/bills/holdings), add investment accounts, edit investment history entries; holding parity with web
- Parity fixtures and tests for tax and trip against the web

- Tax: Singapore estimate + relief tracker (SRS, CPF top-ups, MediSave room, NSman, parents, children, donations) with a 1 Dec reminder; dividends recorded automatically; holding charts at each day's exchange rate
- Bills add themselves on their due date and merge with the bank's copy; rollover budgets; parity with web

- Holding detail page (value since purchase, trades, details, history, ⋯ actions); tap current tab to go to its root; sticky Show less; keyboard: tap outside dismisses, tab bar hides, less bottom space; clearer off switch; square PayNow logo patch
- PayNow QR: official PayNow logo in the middle, plain purple code (no frame or caption)
- PayNow QR styled like the real thing: purple modules, PayNow mark in the middle (error correction H); shared image is the styled card
- PayNow QR: always include an expiry and mark it dynamic — banking apps rejected codes without one

- Control Centre / Lock Screen controls (add, scan, cards) and Add/Scan buttons on the Month widget
- Trip mode: shared ledger on a collection with fewest-transfer settle-up and PayNow requests
- Card rewards: per-card month estimate, minimum-spend progress, caps, best card per category
- Cash-flow calendar, Year in review (shareable), net worth history with milestones and an FI projection

- Statement PDF import: bank/card e-statements read by the new parse-statement function into the import review
- Share a receipt photo or PDF into Finvio: share extension → inbox → scan
- Apple Pay capture: Log card payment intent for a Shortcuts Wallet automation, merged into the bank's email when it arrives
- Notes and #tags on transactions (new notes column): edit in place, tag filter, search, export
- Category rules (shared with the web via prefs) and splitting a purchase across categories
- Double-charge and price-rise alerts
- Safe to spend: a Home card, breakdown with chosen accounts, and a widget
- PayNow request QR (SGQR): a QR for exactly what someone owes you
- Test sweep: every screen rendered across data states, scenarios, live round trips; cap oversized refunds

- Phase 12: reliability and data safety
- Parity: automation rules match the web's lib/smartLinks.js
- Phase 10: smart automation
- Links from Home open on Home's stack, so Back returns to Home

- Investment activity and returns, deeper insights
- Bulk actions, batch split, payee names
- Phase 8: email rules and inbox, two-factor and sign-in, export/import, delete account, profile photo

- Polish from a simulator pass
- Layout, account changes, loading states, lighter syncing
- Refund linking, true amounts, filters, display currency, sticky header; fix receipt library
- Face ID: stop the relock loop, prompt by itself, choose when it locks

- Release to a public SideStore source
- INSTALL.md: first-run steps, notifications, widgets, Siri
- Accessibility and motion pass
- Performance guardrails on three years of heavy data
- Export splits: a split as CSV, or what someone owes as a message or CSV
- Edit portfolio and CPF on the phone
- Fix hide-balances test: no prefs means not hidden
- Hide balances, synced with the web's setting
- Read recurring.type like the web
- Live round-trip test for splits, settling, budgets, bills and goals
- App icon
- Reminders, background refresh and widgets
- Edit collections: create, rename, delete, add and remove transactions
- Plan tab: budgets, bills, goals, forecast
- Link incomes as paybacks or refunds; merge a contact into a friend
- Never recreate a signed-out user's cache
- Splits tab: people, groups, friends, settle up, split editor
- Split settling engine and shared IOU mirroring
- Siri, Shortcuts and home-screen quick actions
- Real screens: shell, accounts, pay card, settings, notifications
- Port investment value history; generate card catalog and bank senders
- Port CPF; test runner that doesn't wait on a lingering xcodebuild
- Port portfolio maths
- Port recurring detection and the cash-flow forecast
- Port dates, card statements, reminders, anomaly, GST/SVC, transfer linking
- Port split maths and ledger selectors; skip unreadable rows
- Phase 3: parity harness; parser and categorizer match the web
- Profile and prefs writes that never drop web-only settings
- Sign-in, two-factor, Face ID lock, and app wiring
- Sync shared splits, emails, learned categories and reference data
